mutations.name: drop-the-all-frozen-check
mutations.why: main installs on answers that show no work although an omp did not freeze (a plain-look answer: no `frozen`, background-work.ts:278 `stopped === asked.length` dropped): a call that starts a job after the look is cut by the quit

mutations.name: drop-the-in-flight-check
mutations.why: freeze no longer counts the tool calls under way (job-gate.ts:74-75 `starting`): a call past the gate registers a job after the freeze
mutations.search: starting == IF CountStarting THEN Cardinality(Underway(o)) ELSE 0

mutations.name: gate-lets-new-calls-through
mutations.why: enter no longer waits while the gate is closed (job-gate.ts:55 `while (this.#closed)` dropped): a call starts a job between the freeze and the quit

mutations.name: drop-the-thaw-on-a-partial-freeze
mutations.why: main stops asking when one omp still runs work but does not thaw the omps that froze (background-work.ts:279-283 loop `thawMember` dropped): they stay frozen, holding their tool calls until the lease

    /\ inbox' = [o \in Omps |-> Append(inbox[o], [kind |-> "thaw", rd |-> rounds])]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gate, call, jobs, outbox, mans, rounds>>
